Illustrations in app/illustrations/

Source: ORIGINAL artwork made for this project (hand-written / script-generated
flat vector SVG). No third-party artwork is included. Free to use and modify as
part of this app; no attribution required.

Files:
  hero-start.svg      overhead barbell press (onboarding hero)
  empty-workouts.svg  holding dumbbells, ready to start (no workouts yet)
  empty-history.svg   person ticking off a training calendar (no history yet)
  rest-recovery.svg   seated on bench, towel + water bottle (rest / recovery)
  timer.svg           runner + stopwatch (timer)
  warmup.svg          standing side stretch on a mat (warm-up / mobility)
  pr.svg              celebrating, arms up, next to a barbell (personal record)
  plan.svg            clipboard checklist + dumbbell (workout plan)

Theming: accent fills/strokes use `currentColor` (set CSS `color`, e.g. #D93A31);
dark ink (hair, shorts, shoes, equipment, outlines) uses
`var(--ill-ink, #1E1B1A)` (set to a light value such as #F4F0EC in dark mode).
Skin tones (#F2C6A7 / #DDA684), white paper/towel (#FFFFFF) and the text marks
inside white cards (#1E1B1A) are fixed so they stay readable in both themes.
Inline the SVG markup (fetch + innerHTML) so currentColor and var(--ill-ink)
follow the theme; via <img> the accent falls back to black.

Previous set (replaced): Open Doodles by Pablo Stanley, CC0 1.0.

Third-party sets checked and NOT used (2026-11):
  Humaaans (CC0) / Open Peeps (CC0) - licence fine, but no gym/fitness poses.
  IRA Design (MIT) - no sport/fitness content.
  Manypixels gallery - licence forbids distributing assets "in packs" and
    advises against using them when central to an app.
  absurd.design free licence - non-commercial only, mandatory linked credit,
    no redistribution.
  Blush - "End Product" not defined, SVG export tied to plans; not relied on.
  Icons8 Ouch - licence page not retrievable (403); free tier needs a link and
    SVG is paid, so excluded.
  unDraw, DrawKit, Freepik, Storyset - licences don't fit (excluded upfront).
